title: Resolving systemic immune-inflammation index components does not establish incremental cross-cycle CRP prediction
abstract: In retrospective NHANES 2007–2008 to 2009–2010 transfer (5175 source,5583 target adults),adding quadratic log neutrophil and lymphocyte counts to SII,WBC and routine covariates changed weighted log-CRP MSE from 1.130479 to 1.128492:gain 0.001987,1000 source-refit/target survey-bootstrap95% interval [-0.007174,0.005750]. Incremental predictive benefit was not established;this is not equivalence or evidence that SII is sufficient. Separate log-component models performed better descriptively;unregularized spline estimates were unstable. Exploratory external validation,not untouched confirmation. AI authored;author self-checks are not independent review.
